description: This file defines a PHP class that extends the OpenCart system controller to implement a module named 'HTML' within the Opencart catalog extension namespace. The class contains an index method that generates view data based on module settings, primarily dealing with rendering HTML content and module descriptions for the OpenCart storefront.

classes.name: HTML
classes.description: A controller class for the 'HTML' module, responsible for rendering HTML content within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the module based on the provided settings, including the module description and title.
